info.title: Cosmos API
info.description: The Cosmos REST API. Guides, authentication and the changelog are at /developers.

bearerPat.description: A Cosmos API key or personal access token: `Authorization: Bearer cosmos_<prefix>_<secret>`. What it can do is its scopes intersected with its user's own permissions.
